philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: The image visualizes freedom not as absence of limits but as skillful navigation within them—the rider’s motion expresses agency precisely because constraints (cones) define the field of action.
alternative_interpretations: It may simply depict a recreational slalom drill with no symbolic intent.
limitations: No textual or contextual cues confirm intentional symbolism; the interpretation relies solely on formal arrangement.

philosophy_interpretations.interpretation: Individual performance gains meaning through collective witnessing—the rider’s act is constituted partly by the presence of others who see and recognize it.
alternative_interpretations: Spectators may be incidental passersby with no engagement in the activity.
limitations: Facial expressions and body orientation of spectators are indistinct; their attention level cannot be verified.
